objective.name: matter.truncate
objective.description: Shorten brique-managed substance to a guarded byte or line boundary.

#root.role: Atomically replace substance with a guarded prefix and advance its revision.

truncate_to._comment: Required: {unit:'bytes'|'lines',size:non-negative integer}. Unit defaults to bytes.

effects.matter_substance: A new prefix file atomically replaces the old substance.
effects.notifications: Subscribers receive matter_truncated without business bytes.

transformation_contract.morphing: A guarded current substance becomes a shorter committed prefix.
invariants: A line-framed byte target must be an LF boundary.
The operation uses replacement rather than in-place truncation; revision-bound read leases opened before the commit become stale and are refused.
success: Revision and committed dimensions advance atomically.
failure: A stale guard, larger target, invalid boundary, or storage failure refuses the operation.
